identified_as.name: FreeToken
identified_as.subtitle: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution
identified_as.local_search: find ~ -maxdepth 4 -iname '*freetoken*' -> no matches. Not on this machine.

what_it_is: An edge-native serving system that treats a personal machine as a unified elastic inference platform rather than a small GPU. Co-designs model layout/loading, expert residency, CPU-GPU execution, agentic state reuse and runtime memory management. Claims 35B on a laptop, 284B on a gaming desktop, 753B GLM-5.2 on one workstation GPU.
mechanisms_of_interest: bandwidth-adaptive CPU-GPU co-execution (does not commit to a fixed offload strategy)
semantic anchor checkpoints for recurrent state and KV caches, so agentic context edits (tool calls, thinking blocks) avoid redundant context recomputation
elastic runtime VRAM reallocation between expert cache and KV without engine restart

blocking_reasons: HARDWARE: evaluated and documented on NVIDIA GPUs only (8GB laptop GPU, gaming desktop, workstation GPU; install docs name RTX 30/40/50). Apple Silicon, Metal and unified memory are not mentioned in the abstract, the paper page, or the repo README. This box is an M3 Ultra with 96 GiB unified memory and no CUDA device.
PLATFORM: desktop installers are Windows and Linux only.

ARCHITECTURE: the system is built around Mixture-of-Experts residency and expert caching. Hawking's current bootstrap parent, Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated, is DENSE, so the expert-residency and LRU-expert-cache machinery — the core of the paper — has nothing to act on even if the hardware matched.
applicability_to_this_machine.not_blocking: The license (Apache-2.0) permits adoption; the obstacle is purely technical fit.

what_to_adopt_instead.idea: semantic anchor checkpoints for agentic KV reuse
what_to_adopt_instead.why: Directly addresses the dominant measured cost in HCLI today. A production HCLI mission prompt is 7257 tokens and llama-server reports n_prompt_tokens_cache=0 — every WorkUnit re-prefills the whole mission from scratch. Anchoring the stable prefix and prefilling only the changed suffix is the same idea FreeToken describes, and directive section 6 already requires it (content-addressed prefix cache, deepest exact prefix restore, changed-suffix prefill).
what_to_adopt_instead.status: adopt as HCLI native design, not as a dependency

what_to_adopt_instead.idea: bandwidth-adaptive execution rather than a fixed offload/parallelism policy
what_to_adopt_instead.why: Matches the directive's RESIDENT_RUNTIME_LIMIT vs ACTIVE_DECODE_LIMIT split: the right concurrency is measured on the machine at hand, not assumed.

revisit_if: FreeToken ships a Metal/MPS backend (watch the repo's backend list)
Hawking's production parent becomes an MoE model AND a Metal backend exists
